display.purpose: Hero and section statements with visible forward momentum.

body.purpose: Readable explanations, outcomes, and supporting copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, metadata, statuses, and compact controls.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Tiny indicators, route lines, and hero emphasis only.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-time intersection reveals using transforms and opacity.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive conversion action used for project enquiries.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 3.6rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1.6rem; padding: .95rem 1.2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--action, #7A46E8); color: var(--text, #F5F2FA); font: 700 .8rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover, #6936D6); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lavender, #C8B7FF); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained route to supporting content or work samples.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 3.6rem; padding: .95rem 1.2rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--lavender, #C8B7FF) 28%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0C0713); color: var(--text, #F5F2FA); font: 700 .8rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .25s, background .25s, transform .25s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--violet, #8B5CFF); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--violet, #8B5CFF) 6%, transparent); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lavender, #C8B7FF); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A high-contrast project enquiry field with an explicit focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .5rem; color: var(--text-muted, #8D8498); font: 600 .75rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 3.25rem; width: 100%; padding: .9rem 1rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--lavender, #C8B7FF) 14%, transparent); border-radius: .55rem; background: var(--surface-strong, #10091A); color: var(--text, #F5F2FA); font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); outline: none; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder, #968EA1); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--violet, #8B5CFF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--violet, #8B5CFF) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact operational status for availability and system state.
components.css: .ds-status { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; padding: .55rem .85rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--lavender, #C8B7FF) 14%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-muted, #8D8498); font: 600 .7rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-status i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #76FFB0); box-shadow: 0 0 12px color-mix(in oklch, var(--success, #76FFB0) 60%, transparent); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lavender, #C8B7FF); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: A work sample that leads with the outcome and keeps delivery facts visible.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-project { padding: 2rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--lavender, #C8B7FF) 14%, transparent); border-radius: 1.2rem; background: var(--surface-raised, #0C0713); color: var(--text, #F5F2FA); } .ds-project > span { color: var(--lavender, #C8B7FF); font: 600 .75rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-project h3 { margin: 2rem 0 1rem; font: 700 clamp(2.4rem, 4vw, 4rem)/.92 var(--font-display, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-project p { max-width: 55ch; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--text, #F5F2FA) 72%, transparent); font: 400 1rem/1.6 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-project strong { display: block; margin-top: 2rem; color: var(--text-muted, #8D8498); font: 600 .7rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-project:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--lavender, #C8B7FF); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mobile Project Action
components.description: The single dominant action at the base of the full-screen mobile menu.
components.css: .ds-mobile-action { padding: .4rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--lavender, #C8B7FF) 28%, transparent); border-radius: .8rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg, #08050D) 88%, transparent); } .ds-mobile-action button { width: 100%; min-height: 3.15rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: .55rem; background: var(--action, #7A46E8); color: var(--text, #F5F2FA); font: 700 .75rem/1 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mobile-action button:hover { background: var(--action-hover, #6936D6); } .ds-mobile-action button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lavender, #C8B7FF); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Hoza should feel like transport signage engineered for a digital studio: fast to read, hard to misinterpret, and visibly pointed forward. Compressed display type supplies velocity while disciplined body copy and strict spacing preserve credibility. The system is dark, technical, and energetic without becoming noisy. Motion is brief and purposeful: it reveals state, direction, or progress, then gets out of the way. Responsive layouts must preserve the same decisive hierarchy from wide screens down to 320px. This system explicitly rejects generic SaaS-template styling, timid visual systems, empty technology claims, unnecessary agency jargon, and decorative complexity that slows comprehension.
keyCharacteristics: One violet signal color used with restraint
Tonal depth before shadow or blur
Direct, accessible actions with visible states
Motion that communicates speed and precision

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only general-purpose accent; success, error, and WhatsApp green are reserved for their semantic roles.

rules.name: The Contrast Is a Feature Rule
rules.body: Primary actions, placeholders, and field states must meet WCAG 2.2 AA before decorative glow is considered.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Use compressed display type for direction and body type for explanation; never make paragraphs perform like headlines.

rules.name: The Compression Limit Rule
rules.body: Display tracking never exceeds -0.04em, and mobile headlines must wrap without clipping or horizontal scroll.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: If a static card needs a large shadow to read as a surface, fix its tone or border instead.

dos: Do make forward momentum tangible through directional composition, brief reveal motion, and clear verbs.
Do show business outcomes beside technical capability.
Do keep the path from interest to enquiry direct and keyboard-complete.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, AA contrast, visible focus, and clean reflow at 320px.
Do use tonal hierarchy before adding blur, glow, or shadow.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS-template styling or interchangeable gradient-card layouts.
Don't create timid visual systems with low-contrast actions or ambiguous hierarchy.
Don't make empty technology claims; every capability needs a concrete use or outcome.
Don't use unnecessary agency jargon where direct language can explain the work.
Don't add decorative complexity that slows comprehension.
Don't use continuous scroll animation when a one-time reveal or native behavior communicates the same idea.
